profile.Name: Buzan
profile.Job: Co-leader of the Black Dragon Ninjas
profile.Personality: A bloodthirsty, traitorous ninja who treats a fight as a game with loot as the prize. He fawns over Dimak and promises her gory gifts.
profile.Backstory: He shares the leadership of the Black Dragon Ninjas with Dimak, and the two keep to the Tower of Ninjas. The Holy Nation wants him for murder, robbery, assault, arson, and kidnapping, and his wanted poster notes a limp.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Gleeful taunts about loot and testing his new sword; calls Dimak 'Makky'.
